assertions.statement: Section 2 states a policy of sustaining and enhancing US global AI dominance.
assertions.qualifications: This records the stated policy objective, including its listed purposes; it does not endorse the objective, measure dominance or establish policy outcomes.

assertions.statement: Section 3 incorporates the AI definition in 15 USC 9401(3).
assertions.qualifications: The statutory definition is referenced, not reproduced or independently verified here. No external statute was ingested.

assertions.statement: Section 4 directs named roles to develop and submit an action plan to the President within 180 days of this order.
assertions.qualifications: Preserve the listed coordination roles and the section 2 policy reference. This historical direction does not establish submission, adoption or implementation. Do not calculate a current deadline from an obsolete reference date.

assertions.statement: Section 5(a) directs review of actions taken pursuant to revoked EO 14110 and identifies a conditional process for changing inconsistent actions.
assertions.qualifications: Only identified actions are addressed; changes or proposed changes must be appropriate and consistent with applicable law. Immediate finalization is not assumed; exemptions are conditional and legally authorized. The paragraph describes EO 14110 as revoked; it does not establish every regulation was rescinded.

assertions.statement: Section 5(b) directs the OMB Director, coordinating with APST, to revise M-24-10 and M-24-18 as necessary within 60 days.
assertions.qualifications: The revision is to make them consistent with section 2 policy. No revised memorandum, completion or present legal status has been independently captured.

assertions.statement: Section 6(a) preserves existing legally granted agency authority and specified OMB functions.
assertions.qualifications: Read the lead-in and both following subclauses together. This statement alone does not resolve a conflict with a particular statute or agency power.

assertions.statement: Section 6(b) makes implementation consistent with applicable law and subject to available appropriations.
assertions.qualifications: A direction is not an appropriation, funding transfer or implementation finding. No expenditure evidence is contained in this instrument.

assertions.statement: Section 6(c) says the order creates no enforceable substantive or procedural right or benefit.
assertions.qualifications: Preserve the listed parties and enforcement scope in the exact passage. This is a source-scoped draft interpretation, not legal advice or an independent legal opinion.
